text:
emily: Thanks for the infra update earlier. Two requests from product: 1) a short customer-facing statement about APAC pilot timing, 2) what the user-visible behavior is if we run out of GPU capacity in a region. Can infra confirm so we don't overpromise?

ben: Quick note: APAC pilot -> pilot customers in late-September, wider availability contingent on rack deliveries. ETA still fluid because some vendors have variable lead times.

emily: Can you quantify 5-10 weeks7 into something we can put in comms? Even a conservative estimate helps.

ben: Conservatively: early Q4 for broader availability if shipments continue, late Q3 for invitation-only pilot. I'll put a one-paragraph blurb.

sophia: On the fallback question: user-visible behaviors depend on customer tier. Hosted customers: we try in-region warm pools, then cross-region within same continent, then model-variant fallback. Dedicated/Private: respect region pinning unless customer opts in to failover.

arjun: What are the expected latency deltas for each step? Product wants numbers to set expectations.

sophia: Rough ballpark (will publish precise benchmarks): in-region warm pool: +10-30ms p95, cross-region (same continent): +50-200ms p95 depending on inter-region distance, model-variant (quantized): p95 impact varies by model size, typical +100-400ms and sometimes quality degradation. We'll produce p50/p90/p95 table.

maria: Action items: - infra to produce one-pager for comms with timeline + fallback UX - legal to review Dedicated contract language on region pinning - product to prepare FAQ draft.

legal-bot: Noted. I'll add a placeholder clause for "region-pinned" customers; Legal to review PR.

capacity-bot: Current regional capacity snapshot (snapshot time: 2141698800):
````
US-West: 90%
US-East: 85%
EMEA: 70%
Asia (APAC): 45%
````

ben: FYI procurement lead times: vendor A ~8 weeks, vendor B ~5-9 weeks (depends on GPU type), reseller lead times vary. I'm starting weekly procurement syncs.

emily: Can infra add a short runbook snippet showing "what happens when region falls below X%"? Ops needs that for runbooks.

sophia: Yes. Suggest threshold triggers: <60% -> proactive throttling signals to busy routes; <40% -> start cross-region warm pooling; <20% -> conserve cache + prefer quantized variants. We'll draft and share.

arjun: I'll open a PR to the runbook and add a small flowchart. If infra posts the latency numbers I can add an SLA impact row.

maria: Perfect. Tentative timeline: runbook PR by Mon, comms one-pager by Wed, Legal review by Fri. Everyone ok?

ben: Ack.

sophia: Ack, will add numbers by Monday end of day.

emily: Thanks all. Please @emily when PRs are up so product can review and merge. :pray:
